h1: BMW N54 Fuel Pump & Injector Repair
lede: Specialist high-pressure fuel pump (HPFP) and injector replacement for BMW N54 twin-turbo engines. Full system adaptation, coding, and leak-testing at our Billericay workshop.

blocks.html: The BMW N54 engine — a twin-turbo straight-six — is known for high-pressure fuel pump (HPFP) and fuel injector wear. Our workshop carries out the full replacement process with factory-level precision, including coding and adaptation to ensure correct fuel delivery.

items: **HPFP replacement** — we access and remove the high-pressure fuel pump, install the new unit, and prime the fuel system.
**Fuel injector replacement** — injectors are accessed, seals are removed and replaced using specialist tools, and new injectors are fitted.
**Fuel system bleeding & leak testing** — the entire system is bled and pressure-tested to confirm there are no leaks.
**Injector coding & adaptation** — each new injector is coded to the engine control unit using BMW-specific diagnostic equipment, ensuring precise fuel metering.
**Full road-test validation** — every repair is driven and monitored to verify fuel pressure and performance under load.

blocks.html: We use genuine BMW parts or OEM-equivalent components, and every repair is backed by our [12-month unlimited-mileage warranty](/warranty).

paras: Includes parts, labour, coding, system bleeding, and final road-test. [Full pricing details →](/pricing-legal-disclaimer)

sections.heading: Our N54 Fuel System Repair Process

steps.title: Inspection & Diagnosis
steps.body: We verify the fault using BMW diagnostic equipment, confirming HPFP pressure and injector performance.

steps.title: Component Access
steps.body: We carefully remove the engine cover, intake components, and fuel lines to access the HPFP and injectors.

steps.title: HPFP & Injector Removal
steps.body: Using specialist tools, we remove the high-pressure fuel pump and each fuel injector, replacing all seals.

steps.title: Installation & Coding
steps.body: New components are fitted, and each injector is coded to the engine control unit for correct fuel delivery.

steps.title: System Bleed & Test
steps.body: We bleed the fuel system, check for leaks, and verify fuel pressure meets BMW specifications.

steps.title: Road Test & Handover
steps.body: Every repair is road-tested to confirm performance, and we walk you through the work completed.

items.q: What are the symptoms of a failing N54 HPFP?
items.a: Common signs include long cranking times before starting, loss of power under acceleration, engine stalling, and a check-engine light with fuel-pressure-related fault codes. If you're experiencing any of these, we recommend an inspection.

items.q: Why do N54 injectors need coding after replacement?
items.a: BMW injectors are matched to the engine control unit through a coding process that ensures precise fuel delivery. Without coding, the engine may run unevenly, misfire, or produce incorrect fuel mixtures.

items.q: How long does the repair take?
items.a: Typical turnaround is 3–5 days, depending on parts availability and the extent of the work required. We'll give you a clear timeline when we quote your job.

items.q: Do you use genuine BMW parts?
items.a: Yes. We use genuine BMW parts or OEM-equivalent components from trusted suppliers. Every part is covered by our 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

items.q: Can you recover my BMW if it's not driveable?
items.a: Yes, we offer nationwide engine recovery from £70. Contact us for a recovery quote if your BMW is stranded.
